key.name: state-pause-start-time
key.description: Used to store pause start time

key.name: state-paused
key.description: Shows if extension is in paused state

key.name: pref-pause-on-destroy
key.summary: Pause time tracking while plugin is not active
key.description: Stop time tracking when screen is locked, hibernated, shutdown or any other case when plugin is not active

key.name: pref-show-seconds
key.description: Set to true to show seconds on indicator

key.name: pref-log-change-state
key.description: Log changes of time tracker state

key.name: pref-indicator-paused-color
key.description: Color of the indicator label in paused state

key.name: pref-reset-time
key.description: Used to store time that will set initially on reset

key.name: pref-break-alarm-interval
key.description: Interval in seconds of non-pause tracking time before alarm triggers, 0 disables the alarm

key.name: pref-start-alarm-days
key.description: Weekdays the start tracking alarm is active on, 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday, an empty array disables the alarm

key.name: pref-start-alarm-from
key.description: Time of day the start alarm timeframe opens, in seconds since local midnight

key.name: pref-start-alarm-to
key.description: Time of day the start alarm timeframe closes, in seconds since local midnight, the alarm is inactive when it is not later than the opening

key.name: pref-start-alarm-delay
key.description: Time in seconds the tracker may stay paused inside the timeframe before the alarm triggers

key.name: state-start-alarm-dismissed
key.description: Local calendar day the start alarm was dismissed for, as YYYYMMDD, 0 means never dismissed
